dedupe_keys.name: murray darling basin water information portal bureau of meteorology

description: The Bureau of Meteorology produced the Murray–Darling Basin water information portal (version 5), which brings together storages, river gauges, water quality, groundwater bores, water allocations and trading information for the Basin's catchments, searchable by town, storage, river or gauge. Coverage is the Murray–Darling Basin in south-eastern Australia, which the page says holds about 40 percent of Australia's agricultural produce. The portal is free to view online. Caveats: the portal page states no licence or download method, and the national Water Data Online service could not be read from the cloud session. Simulation uses: storage levels, allocations and trading for irrigation supply and drought scenarios. Related records: the ABS Water Account (data-abs-water-account-australia) and the urban water performance report (data-bom-national-performance-report-urban-water).
